arguments.summary: REVISION 2 (revision-notice.pdf p1 + rent-roll-revised.xlsx, roll as of 2026-09-01). Three changes only: (1) Suite 002 confirmed active with scheduled rent +$225 to $7,025/month, raising all-suite scheduled gross potential to $68,450/mo = $821,400/yr; (2) cap rate +25 bps to 7.0000%; (3) initial sizing rate +75 bps, from 6.5000% (greater of the 6.5000% note and the 6.00% floor) to 7.2500%. All other facts preserved: 10 suites / 32,150 SF, 9 occupied / 29,070 SF, occupancy 0.9000 units and 0.9042 area, all expiries 2029-08-31 (no near-term rollover), executed Suite 001 amendment (+$350 -> $7,000/mo) still applies, expense inputs, 5% loss, $350/suite other income, 3% management fee, $300/suite reserves, 65% LTV / 1.25x DSCR / 9% debt yield, 1% origination, $45,000 costs, $4,300,000 payoff. Revised results: EGI $783,830; opex before reserves $252,752; NOI before reserves $531,078; NCF $528,078; capitalized value $7,586,830; LTV limit $4,931,440 (binding), DSCR limit $5,160,720, debt yield limit $5,867,534; maximum loan $4,931,440 (DSCR 1.3081x, debt yield 0.1071); net cash-out $537,125 (positive, no shortfall). Versus v1, value fell $244,134 and proceeds fell $158,687 because the cap-rate increase outweighed the $2,488 NOI gain, while the higher sizing rate cut DSCR headroom. New deliverables: artifacts/underwriting-v2.xlsx (Inputs, Rent Roll, Underwriting, Debt, Sensitivity, Changes, Sources; live formulas) and artifacts/memorandum-v2.pdf (7 pages). Prior artifacts underwriting-v1.xlsx and memorandum-v1.pdf remain in the audit archive and were not replaced. Approved sentence preserved exactly: "Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence." Photos, asking price, comps, appraisal and sponsor history remain explicitly unknown.
qualifications: Three rolls exist; conflicts resolved by date. The 2026-09-01 revised certified roll controls; the 2026-08-31 certified roll is superseded (retained only for version comparison) and the 2026-06-30 archive roll is stale and excluded.
The 75 bp increment was applied to the initial sizing rate of 6.5000% (itself the greater of the 6.5000% note rate and the 6.00% floor), giving 7.2500%; the floor remains non-binding.

Underwritten gross potential ($821,400) is the prescribed all-suite scheduled-rent assumption from the controlling roll before the Suite 001 amendment and differs from annual in-place rent of $745,800; the amendment affects in-place rent only.

Reported T12 NOI ($507,593) is cash-basis, excludes any management fee and reserves, and is not an annualized rent roll; it is unchanged by this revision and is not directly comparable to UW NOI or NCF.
Insurance $28,655 is annual expense; $2,000,000 is the general liability aggregate policy limit — different measures.
The loan is sized on a fully amortizing 30-year payment at 7.2500% despite the first 24 months being interest-only; actual IO-period coverage would be higher.

The manager's leased headline (occupied plus pending) remains a disclosed occupancy-overstatement methodology, though the controlling roll again shows zero pending-possession suites, so it has no numeric effect here.
Capitalized value is an income-approach indication only; no appraisal, asking price or market sales/rent comparables are supplied.
Legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews remain incomplete — routine pending diligence with no defect findings asserted.
Not supplied and explicitly unknown (not zero): photographs, asking price, market comps, sponsor history, tenant credit, monthly T12 detail, TI/LC and capital budgets.
Prior-version deliverables are preserved: underwriting-v1.xlsx and memorandum-v1.pdf remain available; this revision adds underwriting-v2.xlsx and memorandum-v2.pdf.
